schema.name: project_id
schema.label: Project Id
schema.description: One row per project. The project this placement (capping) chart config belongs to; its presence is what shows the Placement Progress tab.

schema.name: label
schema.label: Work Area Label
schema.description: Work-area name printed on the chart's Area line (e.g. "Area A - New Breakwater").

schema.name: grid_path
schema.label: Bucket Grid Path
schema.description: Attachment fileId of the bucket-grid lattice JSON: rotationDeg + originU/originV + cellFt + the sparse list of [col,row] cells that exist, plus an optional boundary polyline and optional clipped-edge partials. Every cell polygon and every bucket index derives from it, so without it the tab cannot account coverage.

schema.name: grid_original_name
schema.label: Grid Original Name
schema.description: Filename the PM picked for the bucket-grid lattice JSON. The upload endpoint suffixes a random id for uniqueness, so this keeps the name they recognize.

schema.name: grid_storage_path
schema.label: Grid Storage Path
schema.description: Server-assigned storage path for the bucket-grid lattice JSON, read back after upload. Metadata only -- the file is always fetched by the id in grid_path.

schema.name: aerial_path
schema.label: Aerial Path
schema.description: Attachment fileId of the aerial image drawn behind the grid. Optional -- without it the chart renders on a flat map colour.

schema.name: aerial_original_name
schema.label: Aerial Original Name
schema.description: Filename the PM picked for the aerial image. The upload endpoint suffixes a random id for uniqueness, so this keeps the name they recognize.

schema.name: aerial_storage_path
schema.label: Aerial Storage Path
schema.description: Server-assigned storage path for the aerial image, read back after upload. Metadata only -- the file is always fetched by the id in aerial_path.

schema.name: aerial_georef
schema.label: Aerial Georeference
schema.description: World bounds of aerial_path as {wL,wR,wT,wB} in the project CRS -- the same shape jfb_dredge_config.aerial_georef uses. Also frames the chart view when set, so the imagery fills the map panel exactly.

schema.name: reference_lines_path
schema.label: Reference Lines Path
schema.description: Attachment fileId of the PM's alignment/stationing overlay -- open line work plus text labels, drawn thin over the map. A DXF is read directly; a pre-extracted JSON of {segments, labels} may also carry an `emphasis` array for structures such as a sheet pile wall, which draw heavier and in a warm red. Optional; purely visual.

schema.name: reference_lines_original_name
schema.label: Reference Lines Original Name
schema.description: Filename the PM picked for the alignment overlay. The upload endpoint suffixes a random id for uniqueness, so this keeps the name they recognize.

schema.name: reference_lines_storage_path
schema.label: Reference Lines Storage Path
schema.description: Server-assigned storage path for the alignment overlay DXF, read back after upload. Metadata only -- the file is always fetched by the id in reference_lines_path.

schema.name: design_extents_path
schema.label: Design Extents Path
schema.description: Attachment fileId of the design-region outline (JSON rings). Drawn as a pale filled region under the coverage so the day's work reads against what the design calls for. Optional.

schema.name: design_extents_original_name
schema.label: Design Extents Original Name
schema.description: Filename the PM picked for the design-extents file. The upload endpoint suffixes a random id for uniqueness, so this keeps the name they recognize.

schema.name: design_extents_storage_path
schema.label: Design Extents Storage Path
schema.description: Backing storage path for the design-extents file, mirroring the other asset triples.

schema.name: plant_path
schema.label: Plant Path
schema.description: Attachment fileId of the plant outline (barge/machine footprint, JSON). Lets the PE place the machine on the chart for scale and orientation. Optional.

schema.name: plant_original_name
schema.label: Plant Original Name
schema.description: Filename the PM picked for the plant outline file. The upload endpoint suffixes a random id for uniqueness, so this keeps the name they recognize.

schema.name: plant_storage_path
schema.label: Plant Storage Path
schema.description: Backing storage path for the plant outline file, mirroring the other asset triples.

schema.name: chart_framing
schema.label: Chart Framing
schema.description: How the chart frames the map. Only the exact string 'work' opts into cropping to the design region plus the day's coverage; NULL, '', 'site' and anything unrecognised keep the full site view, so a half-written config row cannot quietly re-frame a live project's chart.

schema.name: active
schema.label: Active
schema.description: Whether this config is live. An inactive row hides the Placement Progress tab without deleting the uploaded grid and aerial.
